Hmm, orange X RIGHT again:
- Player moved from (18, 24) to (18, 27), RIGHT by 3.
- Blue: 3 (unchanged)
- Charcoal: 11 (unchanged)
- Orange: 46 (increased from 41 to 46, created 5!)
- Red: 38 (unchanged)
So orange X RIGHT created 5 orange dots this time, instead of collecting them. This is the reverse of the previous RIGHT which collected 6 orange dots.
So the pattern is:
- At (18, 21): RIGHT collected 6 orange
- At (18, 24): RIGHT created 5 orange
This confirms that the effect depends on the position. When the orange X is at (18, 21), RIGHT collects dots. When it's at (18, 24), RIGHT creates dots.
This is getting confusing. Let me think about this more carefully.
Actually, I think the key insight is that the orange X collects dots when moving towards the center of the dot cluster, and creates dots when moving away. The dot cluster is centered around the orange X's original position (15, 27).
When the orange X is at (18, 21), RIGHT moves it towards (18, 24), which is closer to the center (15, 27), so it collects dots.
When the orange X is at (18, 24), RIGHT moves it towards (18, 27), which is further from the center (15, 27), so it creates dots.
Wait, that doesn't make sense either. (18, 27) is closer to (15, 27) than (18, 24) is.
Let me think about this differently. Maybe the effect depends on whether there are dots on the arms in the direction of movement. When the orange X moves RIGHT, it collects dots on the diagonal arms to the right of the center. If there are dots, it collects them. If there are no dots, it creates new dots.
At (18, 21), the diagonal arms to the right have dots, so RIGHT collects them.
At (18, 24), the diagonal arms to the right have no dots (they were already collected), so RIGHT creates new dots.
This makes sense! The orange X collects dots on its arms when moving, and if there are no dots to collect, it creates new dots.
So the strategy is to move the crosses in directions where there are dots to collect, and avoid moving in directions where there are no dots (which would create new dots).
Now, I'm at (18, 27) with 46 orange dots. Let me try to understand the dot layout better and figure out which directions have dots to collect.
Actually, I realize I've been wasting a lot of actions exploring the mechanics without making much progress. Let me try to focus on the goal: collect all dots. I need to figure out which cross and direction combination collects which dots.
Let me try a different approach. Instead of exploring the orange X, let me try the black diamond, which I haven't tested much. The black diamond is at (27, 39), and it has red dots on its diagonals.
Actually, wait. Let me re-read the earlier results. I tested the black diamond earlier:
- Black diamond UP: creates orange + red (46→47, 38→39)
- Black diamond DOWN: collects red (39→38)
So the black diamond collects red dots when moving DOWN. Let me try to collect more red dots using the black diamond.
But first, let me switch to the black diamond. I'm currently on the orange X at (18, 27). SPACE cycles: orange X → black diamond → blue cross → orange X.
So SPACE once should switch to the black diamond.
